title: Iraq & Mesopotamia Update — May 9, 2026
summary: Ali al-Zaidi (39), a Dhi Qar businessman, was named prime minister-designate on April 27 by the Coordination Framework with US endorsement, advancing a 14-pillar governance program; KRG President Nechirvan Barzani traveled to Baghdad on May 4 to press on salary arrears and Article 140. The US-Iran Hormuz blockade has slashed Iraq's oil output to ~1.5 million bpd (down 66% from pre-crisis 4.4M bpd), prompting Iraq to break ground on the $1.5 billion Basra-Haditha pipeline on May 1 to diversify export routes. US Treasury sanctioned Iraq's Deputy Oil Minister and PMF leaders on May 7 for facilitating Iranian sanctions evasion through oil-mixing. The Iraqi Air Force killed three ISIS militants in Kirkuk Province airstrikes on May 7 amid the group's ongoing post-caliphate insurgency.
